path.description: Workspace-relative UTF-8 text file to change.

expected_sha256.description: Optional. Omit it to use the version you last read or wrote; pass a digest only to name a specific version.

old_text.description: Single edit: exact text occurring once in the file.

new_text.description: Single edit: replacement text; empty deletes.

edits.description: Several non-overlapping replacements in one call.

replace_all.description: Replace every non-overlapping occurrence of old_text.

append_text.description: Text added after all replacements; no automatic newline.
